BEH-01_initialDiscovery.description: Discovery returns nonempty properties without auto-selecting property or querying availability/quote

BEH-02_explicitSelection.description: Explicit click on 'Chọn cơ sở này & Xem phòng' loads room inventory for selected property

BEH-03_immediateInvalidationAndAutocompl.description: Typing into combobox invalidates previous selection, queries autocomplete, sets aria-expanded='true'

BEH-04_clearAction.description: Clicking clear button resets input value to empty and property selection to null

BEH-05_syntheticHoldReservation.description: End-to-end synthetic hold reservation navigates to hold countdown view

BEH-06a_rentalModeToggle.description: Switching rental mode from overnight to hourly updates aria-pressed and adapts date picker controls

BEH-07_autocompleteLoadingState.description: Typing into combobox renders immediate in-flight loading message in popup DOM
BEH-07_autocompleteLoadingState.popupLoadingText: Đang tìm kiếm cơ sở lưu trú...

BEH-08_autocompleteEmptyState.description: Typing an unmatched keyword renders empty state message in popup DOM after debounce
BEH-08_autocompleteEmptyState.popupEmptyText: Không tìm thấy cơ sở lưu trú nào phù hợp.

BEH-10a_typingDebounce.description: Rapid keystrokes within 100ms throttle intermediate requests to single debounced query
BEH-10a_typingDebounce.finalResolvedResult: Khách Sạn Biển Đông Đà Nẵng

BEH-06b_dateEditAndLateQuoteReset.description: Actual manual date input edit, date range boundary reset, and late quote recalculation were not exercised at runtime in browser session
BEH-06b_dateEditAndLateQuoteReset.limitation: Only rental mode button toggling (overnight <-> hourly) was exercised at runtime

BEH-09_computedFocusVisibleRetention.description: Tab navigation and activeElement tracking were exercised; source classes contain focus-visible:ring-indigo-500, but computed outline/ring retention under active Tab was not measured via CDP computed styles or focused screenshot
BEH-09_computedFocusVisibleRetention.limitation: Presence of CSS classes does not constitute proof of browser-rendered focus ring retention

BEH-10b_delayedStaleResponseRace.description: Delayed in-flight response race condition (where request 1 resolves after request 2) was not exercised because the fixture server responds synchronously without artificial network latency injection
BEH-10b_delayedStaleResponseRace.limitation: Debounce was observed, but race condition ordering was not simulated in browser

BEH-11_exercisedBrowserErrorAndRetry.description: Live fixture server returned 200 OK across all runs; runtime error alert and retry button were not exercised in browser
BEH-11_exercisedBrowserErrorAndRetry.unitEvidence: Component error state signals (propertiesError) and retryLoadProperties() method verified in Vitest unit suite (public-booking.page.spec.ts), template contains <div *ngIf="propertiesError()" role="alert">

networkAudit.engine: Loopback Fixture Inbound Audit Log & Chrome DevTools Network Inspector

externalAssetsObserved: https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/inter/... (browser font request, cache attribution unverified)
